items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
Works in confined quarters: Yes
4-7 years of related experience
Experience using UCR online systems, including Oracle, Facilities work order system, and the Asset Management System

For all purchase requests, independently analyze order information and exercise purchasing skills to (1) determine vendor selection, (2) negotiate the best terms for price, quality, availability, warranties, return policies, and delivery, and (3) solicit quotations from multiple suppliers and perform comparisons when appropriate. Place orders in a timely manner to assure prompt delivery of needed supplies and services. As a seasoned and experienced professional, review a high volume of orders to verify the COA (chart of accounts) and identify a wide range of complex and unique issues that require special handling, such as fabrications, radioactive chemicals, controlled substances, hardware/software that transmit data, and items that qualify for a partial sales tax exemption. For business contracts, restricted items, and orders that exceed $15,000, prepare purchase requisitions, in their entirety, for submission to central purchasing. Reduces risk to the University by ensuring departmental compliance with procurement policy and procedures. (45% time)

As the purchasing specialist in the department, provide expert advice on the various UC and Campus Agreements and provide guidance to requestors regarding the appropriate sources and procedures for obtaining different goods and services such as directing them on how to order through Oracle, UCR Receiving Services, or web recharge for campus services. Identify products/services that require review by other campus departments such as PD&C or ITS and obtain pre-approvals before submitting to central purchasing. Work with building inspectors, ITS, and facilities supervisors in various trades including electrical, plumbing, HVAC, day crew, etc. to make purchases of equipment or over-sized items that require building permits. Provide excellent customer service by initiating and following up on communications with requestors, campus partners, and vendors. Keep requestors informed about delays, back orders, or other problems with orders. Provide technical support in Oracle such as applying percentages to multiple COAs, and helping them resolve issues such system errors, incomplete shipments, price variances, cancellations, etc. Coordinate with Department Receiver on deliveries and installation of equipment and services as well as RMAs and shipping returns. Ensure adequate coverage in stockroom and receiving area at all times, overseeing the student workers in the absence of their supervisor. (30% time)

Chemistry Equipment Manager; Manage the tagging, selling, loaning, transferring, or disposing of the department's equipment items including donated and fabricated units. As part of the annual inventory check, ensure the accuracy and completeness of equipment records in the Asset Management System; maintain accurate count, location, ownership, and usage status of the department's equipment inventory list by updating the AMS as changes occur. Keep faculty and researchers informed about the rules involving the disposition of any equipment or unwanted items. (5% time)

Interpret and apply University policies and procedures by leveraging broad knowledge of University guidelines to advise faculty, researchers, and staff on procurement rules and limitations, including purchasing furniture, hiring independent contractors, and providing SSPRs for items exceeding $10K purchased with federal funds. Exercise sound judgment when interpreting policies and terms and conditions to mitigate risk to the University while determining the most appropriate methods for acquiring goods and services. (5% time)

Develop advanced spreadsheets and supporting documentation to facilitate analysis. Identify documentation requirements for all transactions, obtain the appropriate records—including essential backup information—and ensure they are properly e-filed. (5% time)
Keep current on changes in University policies and procedures and disseminate updates as necessary to ensure departmental compliance. Participates in professional development and training. (5% time)
Perform other duties as assigned by the manager. (5% time)
Read/Comprehend: Constantly
Write: Constantly
Perform Calculations: Constantly
Communicate Orally: Constantly
Reason & Analyze: Constantly
Bend: Occasionally
Sit: Frequently
Stand: Occasionally
Walk: Occasionally
Ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally.
Strong skills in the use of ERP/financial systems (such as Oracle, PeopleSoft, SAP, Banner, etc.).
Analytical skills necessary to evaluate the quality and cost effectiveness of multiple and complex purchasing options.
Strong level of proficiency in the use of standard spreadsheet and word processing software.
Ability to read and interpret terms and conditions of contracts.

Rigorous Follow-Through & Ownership: Exceptional ability to manage tasks through to completion, ensuring critical action items are tracked, followed up on, and closed out without letting details fall through the cracks.
Demonstrated reliability in coordinating across departments, establishing clear accountability, and closing communication loops to prevent oversights
Proven capacity to systematically prioritize competing demands, maintain meticulous records, and track multi-step workflows in a fast-paced environment.
